主要内容: On February 10, 2014, the Compensation Committee of Medallion Financial Corp. approved fiscal year 2013 bonuses to its executives, including Alvin Murstein (Chief Executive Officer) with a $500,000 cash bonus (1.01% increase over 2012), Andrew Murstein (President) with a $1,400,000 cash bonus (8.57% increase), Larry Hall (Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer) with a $115,000 cash bonus (8.70% increase), Michael Kowalsky (Executive Vice President) with a $160,000 cash bonus (3.20% increase), and John Taggart (Chief Executive Officer and President of Medallion Bank) with a $250,000 cash bonus (8.70% increase). The Committee also approved base salary increases for these executives. Additionally, restricted common stock was granted under the 2009 Employee Restricted Stock Plan, with shares vesting in one-third increments over three years.
